status_summary: Executive Order 14181 (signed 2025-01-24, published 2025-01-31) directs Reclamation to deliver more Central Valley Project water, including by increasing storage and conveyance. On 2026-01-23 Interior approved the record of decision for the 1.5 million acre-foot Sites Reservoir, with Reclamation funding up to 25 percent of cost, and reported more than 200,000 acre-feet secured for the project within a year. The order does not mention the 2018 western water memorandum, and no action on water control manuals, working-group consolidation, forecast-informed operations or WIFIA was found, so the match is partial and limited to California.

timeline.event: Executive Order 14181 signed, directing Reclamation to increase Central Valley Project water deliveries and identify storage projects (published 2025-01-31).
Interior approved the record of decision for Sites Reservoir and reported added Central Valley Project water in the order's first year.
